polar_scope: Adopted OpenFAST reference section polars, NOT polars from Maza et al. (2023), who used UVLM. No claim of an exact SNL100-00 v2 AeroDyn dataset.
mapping: Linear interpolation by section thickness between NACA64 18%, DU21 21%, DU25 25%, DU30 30%, DU35 35%, DU40 40.5%, and Cylinder1 100%; geometric transition sections are approximate.

comparison_reference.publication: Maza, Turello, Preidikman and Flores (2023), Mecanica Computacional XL, 957-965
comparison_reference.role: Published model results for comparison, not experimental ground truth or fitting targets.

baseline_2011_context.scope: Original 2011 baseline. Do not replace the deliberately different Maza isolated-blade conditions or identify this as v2 without revision evidence.
